InstalledExtension.description:
One extension installed in the target infobase, as reported by the platform.

`ibcmd` reads the applied name prefix from a saved DB configuration.
The agent provider cannot attest that property and reports `None`.

name_prefix.description:
`None` means the selected provider cannot attest the applied prefix;
`Some("")` is a known empty prefix.

version.description: `None` when the platform reported the field empty.

Provider.description: Исполнитель. Имя называет того, кто делает работу, а не способ его запуска.

oneOf.description: Агентский shell: Конфигуратор в агентском режиме или шлюз автономного сервера.

ProviderReceipt.description:
Квитанция о выборе исполнителя — одна форма у всех операций.

Объясняет принятое решение и не предлагает другого: неиспользованные альтернативы
не перечисляются, потому что выбор вызывающему не принадлежит. `selected: null`
значит, что выбор состоялся и никто не подошёл: каждый пропущенный назван с причиной.

RequestedInventory.description:
What the read was asked for, named as data.

A change preview names its `target` and `action` as fields; the read names its
subject the same way, so a caller pairs the answer with its request without
parsing the wording of `plan`.

oneOf.description: Every extension installed in the infobase.
One extension by its platform name.

SkippedProvider.description: Исполнитель, пропущенный до выбранного, и почему.

description: Result of reading the extension composition of an infobase.

extensions.description:
Extensions in the order the platform reported them.

That order is not the creation order and the platform does not document one,
so callers must not rely on it.

plan.description: What the apply would do, named without any secret from the connection string.

provider.description: Квитанция о выборе исполнителя; `None`, пока выбор не начинался.

provider_dispatched.description:
Whether an executor got this command's work: a process was started to do it, or the
request's command was handed to a running session. Starting or opening a session and
its own service commands are not work. `false` in a preview; any failure answers the
shared refusal form, without this field.

Reading the composition is an action, not a look: the platform starts, a session
opens, the account authenticates and a journal trace is left. So the read has a
preview too, and in it `extensions` is empty because nothing was asked.

requested.description: The subject of the read, present in the preview and in the answer alike.
